verdict: Alphabet's revenue rose 24% to $119.8B and Cloud grew 82% — but the quarter's real headline is a $99B paper gain on its investment portfolio, which tripled net income to $112.2B.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $2.31 a year ago — mostly the investment gain

segments.name: Google Services
segments.note: Search ($63.3B, +17%), YouTube ads ($11.1B, +13%), Google Network ads ($7.3B) and subscriptions, platforms and devices ($12.9B, +15%) — the ad-funded core; up 15% YoY.

segments.name: Google Cloud
segments.note: Cloud computing and AI services sold to businesses; up 82% YoY, and its operating profit more than tripled to $8.8B.

segments.name: Other Bets
segments.note: Early-stage ventures like Waymo self-driving cars; tiny revenue and a $1.8B operating loss this quarter.

segments.name: Hedging gains
segments.note: Gains on currency hedges Alphabet runs at the corporate level (a $112M loss a year ago).

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Engineers and researchers building Search, AI and Cloud — Alphabet's biggest running cost.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling ads and devices, and promoting Google's products.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: The back office — legal, finance and running the company.

otherDetail: Other income of $97,983M — almost entirely a $99.0B net gain on equity securities (stocks Alphabet owns, marked up in value; unrealized, not cash from customers).
follow100Note: The $81.80 of 'Other income' in each $100 is the paper gain on Alphabet's stock holdings — it dwarfs the operating business this quarter. Chart scale note: because that gain is so large, the chart's bands are sized against $171.8B (gross profit plus the gain), not revenue alone. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: The investment gain makes this quarter's flows wider than revenue: the chart is scaled to gross profit plus other income ($171.8B). Net income of $112,193M is before $86M of preferred stock dividends; net income available to common stockholders was $112,107M, on which the $9.11 EPS is based.

takeaways.title: A paper gain tripled the bottom line
takeaways.text: Net unrealized gains on equity securities added $99.0B before tax. Strip them out and net income would have been roughly $35B — still strong, but the $112.2B headline is an investment story, not an ads story.

takeaways.title: Cloud is booming
takeaways.text: Google Cloud revenue jumped 82% to $24.8B and its operating profit more than tripled to $8.8B, while Search grew 17% to $63.3B.

takeaways.title: Free cash flow went negative
takeaways.text: Capital spending hit $44.9B in one quarter — more than the $39.1B of operating cash flow — as Alphabet builds AI data centers. It also raised $49.6B of new equity and $20.3B of debt in the quarter to fund the build-out.

oneTimers: Other income includes a $99.0B net gain on equity securities (mostly unrealized). Alphabet itself quantifies the effect: the gain raised the tax bill by $21.9B, net income by $77.1B and EPS by $6.26.
In June 2026 Alphabet raised $49.6B by issuing stock and mandatory convertible preferred shares, plus $20.3B of senior notes — war-chest funding for AI infrastructure, not an operating result.
